items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Joe Louis would go there on exhibition boxing tours, he'd say 'Buck, you don't believe it, you've got to go over there and see.'

ctx.x: Well another case like in California. I wanted to come to New York from California, I'd heard so much about it. So now, I'd heard so much about it, England and France and people would come back when I was in the Teresa, like Joe Louis would go there on exhibition boxing tours, he'd say 'Buck, you don't believe it, you've got to go over there and see.' And other people

would tell me. Everybody told me about Paris and London. So I just saved up enough money. No I didn't either. Yes I did. This is the first time. I saved my own money. Me and Earl Hines' drummer, Bishop, Wallace Bishop and another trumpet player which I didn't need, but he and I were close friends. We all saved up enough money.
